name: 48226 · Detroit, MI
findings: ZIP 48226 (Detroit) has 307 nonprofit organizations. 142 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 115 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48226 (Detroit) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 48226 (Detroit) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 10.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 81 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
